{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the highest sample_seq per patient
df = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rate per site
response_rates = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

# Find the site with the highest response rate
best_site = response_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = response_rates.max()

print(f"Response rates by site:\n{response_rates}")
print(f"\nHighest response rate: {best_rate:.4f} at {best_site}")"}
